rules: No new generic ledger/queue/auth/signature system when current ACS or Host already owns the fact.
Defensive wrappers may be removed or merged when the same boundary is already enforced; record the short reason with the code change.
Only add a regression for a real affected function or direct correctness boundary; no new all-platform research matrix.
Do not remove actual identity, target or effect truth to obtain superficial success.
Prefer actual functional flow and minimal necessary integration tests over more schema/protocol layers.
